_comment: Server-side only. Lives in the project root, NOT in viewer/, so the static file server (which is rooted at viewer/) can never serve it.
_auth_comment: The /chat, /remember, /speak shared-secret token is NOT here — it lives in a git-ignored .env at the vault root as JARVIS_TOKEN=..., loaded by server.py's AuthGate. Keeping it out of this file means config.json stays safe to read, copy, or eventually commit without leaking the secret.

claude_cli._comment: Runs /chat through the `claude -p` CLI on your Claude Code subscription: slower than the HTTP API, but no per-token API billing and no API key anywhere.

mcp._comment: Same scope as jarvis-dashboard: GHL + CallRail only, both read-only connectors. AccuLynx and any Postgres/reporting/infra server are never wired in here. Each server dir has its own gitignored .env with its credentials.

anthropic_api._comment: Unused while backend is 'claude-cli'. To switch: set backend to 'anthropic-api' and put the key in the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable — never in this file, so it cannot leak by someone copying config.json around.

retrieval._capture_links_comment: How many existing notes a new /remember capture is wired to. The first is also where its star is born in the galaxy.

tts._comment: Local Piper neural voice for /speak. The browser's own speechSynthesis falls back to espeak-ng on this machine, which sounds robotic; Piper is a real neural voice, offline, with no API key and no per-word cost. Set enabled to false to go back to browser speech.
tts._python_comment: Piper is installed in a pipx venv, so it is not importable from the python running server.py — the worker runs under this interpreter instead. Reinstall with: pipx install piper-tts
tts._model_comment: en_GB-alan-medium: natural British male, ~0.55s per answer once warm. en_GB-cori-high is slightly richer but ~2.4s, which is too slow to feel conversational. Models live in ~/.local/share/piper-voices/ (from huggingface.co/rhasspy/piper-voices).
tts._length_scale_comment: Phoneme duration multiplier; >1 is slower. A touch above 1 reads as measured rather than rushed.

history._comment: Per-session conversation memory, kept server-side in RAM only.
